description: Maya has the key to her late grandfather's workshop and must make the family decision about where the tools go, how one dangerous machine is stored, and who takes responsibility for selected equipment.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Workshop Key Holder and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Their late grandfather's workshop must be cleared before the house is listed for sale.
shared_context.S2: The workshop contains an old wood lathe, a table saw, a drill press, six clamps, a workbench, a planer, and a set of chisels.
shared_context.S3: Maya has the workshop key and is making the final call about the tools' destinations, safety handling, and handoffs.
shared_context.S4: The table saw is currently standing beside the workshop's unlocked side door.
shared_context.S5: The family has a routine of going around the room once before a shared family decision is finalized, so everyone can mention anything that should affect the plan.

PF1.text: Jonah found a handwritten inventory card inside the workshop cabinet saying the wood lathe should go to Elm Street makerspace; the makerspace confirmed to him that it can accept the lathe on 2027-02-14, but this has not reached the group.

PF2.text: Priya's occupational-safety instructor reviewed photographs of the workshop and recommended that the table-saw blade be removed and the saw be kept in a locked cabinet whenever it is not being used; Priya has not shared that recommendation.

PF3.text: Luis needs the drill press and all six clamps for his electrical-apprenticeship project, and he will take responsibility for maintaining them if they are handed to him by 2027-01-31; he has not raised this with Maya.

PF4.text: Renee measured her garage and has 2.4 meters of clear wall while the workshop cabinet is 2.2 meters wide, so she can store the workbench, planer, and chisels there through 2027-06-30; she has not proposed this arrangement to the family.

acceptance_conditions: The wood lathe must be assigned to Elm Street makerspace.
The lathe handoff must be set for 2027-02-14.
The table-saw blade must be removed.
The table saw must be kept in locked storage.
Luis must receive the drill press and all six clamps.
The workbench, planer, and chisels must be stored in Renee's garage.
Renee's storage arrangement must run through 2027-06-30.
A commitment must document the lathe handoff.
A commitment must document the table-saw safety preparation and locked storage.
A commitment must document Luis's equipment handoff by 2027-01-31.
A commitment must document Renee's storage arrangement through 2027-06-30.
Jonah's inventory-card and makerspace information must be cited by Maya.

content_checks.C5: len(decisions['luis_tools']) == 2 and 'drill press' in decisions['luis_tools'] and 'six clamps' in decisions['luis_tools']
content_checks.C8: any(c['recipient'] == 'Elm Street makerspace' and c['date'] in ['2027-02-14', 'February 14, 2027', 'February 14th, 2027', 'February 14th 2027'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('safety' in c['type'] and 'blade' in c['detail'] and ('locked cabinet' in c['detail'] or 'locked storage' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['recipient'] == 'Luis' and c['date'] in ['2027-01-31', 'January 31, 2027', 'January 31st, 2027', 'January 31st 2027'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: 'Renee' in decisions['remaining_tools_storage'] and 'garage' in decisions['remaining_tools_storage'] and any(c['owner'] == 'Renee' and 'June 30' in c['date'] and 'garage' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jonah's inventory card and makerspace confirmation change the lathe destination to Elm Street makerspace and fix its handoff date at 2027-02-14.
Priya's safety recommendation changes the table-saw plan by requiring the blade to be removed, the saw to be kept in a locked cabinet, and those actions to be recorded in a safety commitment.
Luis's apprenticeship need changes the assignment to the drill press and all six clamps and fixes his handoff deadline at 2027-01-31.
Renee's measurements change the remaining-tools plan to storage in her garage and set the storage end date at 2027-06-30.
